descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S10 How long the physician waits: seconds until an open tab shows sign-in after a revoke, and until the code email arrives

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Disabling a physician turns their access off immediately on every device, even without a separate revoke call. Disabling and revoking signs them out immediately, and they cannot request a new code. … (UAT OAT-01 step 9; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 8; TFA-94513 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local stack: a fresh account signed in through the real form, with a chart open in the tab. The email arrival seconds come from S01's 10 sends per mailbox.

When Call sessions:_revokeForEmail and start a timer. Measure the seconds until the tab shows Send sign-in code: (1) with no interaction for 6 minutes; (2) after one tap on the chart; (3) after switching to another tab and back. Ten runs per case.

Then Median and worst seconds per case are recorded next to Q7's target once Daniela sets one, and S01's arrival seconds next to Q12's. The build is expected to clear only at the next server call, the 5-minute keep-alive after activity, or on return to the tab; with no interaction the chart may stay on screen for the whole wait.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Timings are reported against Q7 (revoke -> sign-in) and Q12 (email arrival) as targets, not pass/fail: OAT-01 has no timing target and UAT 3.5 covers Save Note and Generate only. A chart still on screen after the 6-minute wait with no interaction is recorded for Q7, not failed.

Where it ran: local newspec-a (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-a.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: PERF · Performance timing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-a.

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S10

How long the physician waits: seconds until an open tab shows sign-in after a revoke, and until the code email arrives

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

New local lane newspec-a: status record-only in newspec-a/results.json → needs a person (record only, the lane says it cannot decide / a person decides → a person looks).

How it is tested (newspec-a/plan.json, automatable: yes): New timing spec: per case a fresh account signed in through the real form, a chart open; sessions:_revokeForEmail starts the timer; poll until 'Send sign-in code' shows: (1) no interaction, up to 6 min; (2) one tap on the chart right after the revoke; (3) a tab switch away and back (visibilitychange). 10 runs per case, run in parallel workers. Median/worst seconds recorded; record-only (no target, Q7). — Pure browser timing on the local stack with the admin revoke hook; no pass/fail threshold exists, so the result is record-only.

Detail:

Seconds from sessions:_revokeForEmail to 'Send sign-in code' on an open chart, 10 runs per case, fresh account signed in through the form: no interaction median 1.24 s, worst 3.40 s (all 10 cleared without input: the session row is in every query's read set, so the open subscriptions re-run and refuse at once); one tap median 1.21 s, worst 2.23 s; tab switch median 0.63 s, worst 5.75 s (visibilitychange hidden->visible dispatched in the page: headless tabs never go hidden). No run kept the chart on screen. No target exists (Q7); e-mail arrival seconds (Q12) are S01's and need a real mailbox, not measured here. 8 of the first 30 runs failed in SETUP under load (sign-in 500 / response timeout) and were re-run. Manual gap: e-mail arrival seconds (Q12) need a real mailbox.

Evidence: 3 attached; 1 not attached:

  • newspec-a/evidence/oat01-s10 — a folder (60 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs, which sign in their own fixture accounts and need the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
